scripts.postinstall: npm run build:assets && npm run build:core
scripts.pretest: npm run build:assets && npm run build:core
scripts.test:coverage: npm run build:assets && npm run build:core && node --test --experimental-test-coverage tests/*.test.js
scripts.app:deploy: npm test && npm run build:assets && vercel --prod
scripts.redeploy: npm run db:reset && npm run db:deploy && npm run app:deploy
